item.title: Trump warns to hit Iran ‘twenty times harder’ if Strait of Hormuz oil flow stopped
item.description: Donald Trump has warned that the United States would strike Iran “twenty times harder” if Tehran attempts to stop the flow of oil through the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. In a post on social media, Trump issued a strong warning amid rising tensions in West Asia. “If Iran does anything that stops the flow of oil within the Strait of Hormuz, they will be hit by the United States of America TWENTY TIMES HARDER than they have been hit thus far,” he wrote. item.title: Long queues outside LPG distribution centre in Bhubaneswar amid delivery delays
item.description: Long queues were seen outside an LPG distribution centre in Bhubaneswar. Residents gathered to collect gas cylinders amid delays in delivery, with many customers claiming they had been waiting for weeks despite booking their refills. Customers were seen standing in line since Monday night outside the Lingaraj HP Gas station at Khandagiri, holding their gas passbooks and waiting to receive their cylinders. item.title: Bodies of man, woman found near railway gate in Balasore; probe on
item.description: The bodies of a man and woman were found near the Baghbali railway gate under Jaleswar police station limits in Odisha's Balasore district on Tuesday, raising concern in the area. The exact cause of their deaths remains unclear, and railway police have launched an investigation into the incident. According to preliminary information, the two individuals reportedly died after being run over on the railway track late on Monday night. item.title: IAF deploys Mi-17 V5, drops 66,000 litres water to douse Arunachal forest fire
item.description: The Indian Air Force (IAF) on Tuesday deployed a Mil Mi-17 to combat a major forest fire in the Mebo and Sigar areas of Pasighat, releasing around 66,000 litres of water in multiple sorties to contain the blaze. In a post on X, the IAF shared images and videos showing the scale of the fire and the aerial operations carried out to bring the flames under control. The force said the helicopter undertook several water-dropping sorties to limit the spread of the fire and safeguard nearby habitations.

item.title: Youth’s death sparks protest outside Nimapada police station in Puri
item.description: Tension prevailed in Nimapada area of Odisha’s Puri district after the body of a youth was found hanging from a tree on Tuesday morning. The incident prompted villagers to stage a protest in front of the local police station while keeping the body there. The deceased has been identified as Subrat Bhoi.
